about_the_game:
Love Cast n Chill and want to support its future? The Supporter Pack is a great way to help us keep developing this game — and future ones too!

As a thank you, you’ll get to choose between two loyal companions: a Bernese Mountain Dog or a Maine Coon cat. Either one makes a great boat buddy for your trips into the mountains.

Just a heads-up: This DLC is purely a show of support. The companion options don’t impact gameplay or provide any in-game advantage. But they do look super cool!
